Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: architectural editorial photograph for the apartment design scheme 琥珀曲光, amber.
Create one exceptionally crisp, realistic professional interior photograph. Landscape 3:2 composition, native resolution at least 1536x1024, preferably 1536x1024. It is a real compact 75.1 square metre two-bedroom Shanghai city apartment, modest 2.7 metre flat ceiling, not a hotel or villa. Coherent distinctive warm modern sculptural vocabulary: warm ivory fine plaster, pale natural quarter-cut oak with visible fine grain, honed light limestone, restrained aged bronze, accents of hand-blown amber glass and cinnamon. Bright believable daylight with warm restrained practical lights, balanced exposure and true material colour. Photographic subtle imperfections, real seams and construction details, straight verticals and correct perspective, moderate architectural wide lens without distortion. Shanghai residential buildings and green urban trees if a view is visible. No sea, mountains or snow. All furniture domestic scale for the stated small room. No text, letters, watermarks, logos, UI, people, collages or split views. No dark walnut theme, overlarge spaces, double-height ceilings, grand hotel lobby, coarse jute or shag rugs, saturated blue furniture. No ornate classicism, arched ceilings or palace architecture.

rooms.living: Room: combined living and dining 21.4sqm, long narrow rectangle approximately 3.3m wide by 6.5m long. Camera stands by the balcony looking inward toward the dining end. Living furniture nearer camera, a dining table for four in the background. On the RIGHT wall only is a single 2.05m-long, exquisitely crafted cinnamon/terracotta soft aniline leather sofa, sculptural gentle curve and rounded end, low back with elegant relaxed tailored cushions. Opposite on LEFT is a very shallow floating pale oak media ledge with a wall-mounted black TV. Centre coffee table is a small smoky-glass oval with very thin aged bronze frame, transparent and visually light. Under it a beautiful fine-wool ivory and champagne rectangular rug with subtle mineral-grey irregular bands, flat dense luxurious pile (clearly not jute/shag). Airy ivory walls, pale oak flooring, no full dark wood wall cladding. One restrained sculptural hand-blown amber-glass ribbon pendant above living seating, adapted to a low ceiling. At rear a compact oval pale oak dining table approximately 1.3m long with four thin oak chairs upholstered ivory, small amber pendant above table, shallow pale oak storage. Main sofa right side dominates the scene without filling the entire room. Soft daylight enters from behind the photographer, realistic sunny urban apartment. Flat simple ceiling with a few discreet spotlights; not multi-tier tray ceiling. A small ceramic bowl and one branch vase only.
rooms.dining: Room: the DINING view of combined 21.4sqm long narrow living+dining room approximately 3.3m by 6.5m. Camera at the apartment entrance looking outward through the dining area toward living and the large balcony window. Compact oval 1.3m pale quarter-cut oak dining table in foreground, four elegant slim oak chairs upholstered warm ivory, a small hand-blown amber-glass sculptural pendant. Beyond dining, a cinnamon soft-aniline-leather 2.05m curved sofa is along the LEFT wall (because camera faces balcony), with a gently rounded end, soft tailored cushions. Opposite RIGHT wall is a shallow pale-oak TV ledge and wall mounted black TV. Small transparent smoky-glass oval coffee table on thin bronze frame, fine ivory/champagne wool rug with subtle mineral-grey bands, no jute or shag. Far end balcony has a very wide uninterrupted fixed central glass pane and narrow opening side panels, no mullion across the central view, urban Shanghai towers and trees outside. A low curved pale-oak bench with ivory cushion is glimpsed in the 5sqm balcony; one olive-green potted plant at side. Light oak floor, ivory plaster walls, modest flat 2.7m ceiling, brighter airy modern sculpture, domestic compact scale. Photograph foreground table clearly and view beyond naturally, not excessively elongated space. No wall of dark walnut and no blue upholstery.
rooms.balcony: Room: enclosed narrow 5.0sqm balcony with large window, photographed from the living threshold facing the window at a slight angle, compact real domestic space. The main window is ONE WIDE uninterrupted fixed central glass pane extending from low sill to lintel; only very NARROW operable vertical side panels left and right, no vertical mullions or crossbar bisecting the central view, clean slim bronze aluminium frames. Shanghai residential towers with trees beyond, soft bright clear daylight. A quiet pale quarter-cut oak curved bench at low sill with cream tailored cushion and one pale clay cushion, rounded bench ends, approximately 1.7m long. One small smoky-glass/bronze side table and one olive tree in smooth warm grey ceramic pot at side, enough open floor to circulate. Fine ivory plaster side walls, light honed limestone tile floor. Ceiling modest flat 2.7m. Warm elegant continuous design vocabulary, not a garden pavilion, not an outdoor terrace. No laundry visible, no large furniture, no chair crowding the narrow balcony.
rooms.master: Room: compact 13.5sqm master bedroom photographed from doorway with correct cosy dimensions, main bed and contemporary L-shaped corner window clearly visible. A domestic 1.8m wide bed with low pale-oak floating platform and slim integrated bedside ledges, dressed in tactile oatmeal linen with pale clay throw laid neatly over foot. Headboard composition: light warm textured stone in two restrained contemporary inset panels with pale quarter-cut oak framing, quietly lit by subtle warm grazing light, no dark slatted walnut wall. Small amber bedside light and fine bronze reading light. Modern corner window with narrow bronze frame and natural ivory sheer curtains, urban Shanghai residential view, corner seating ledge. Pale oak floor, a high quality dense fine wool ivory/champagne rug with subtle grey mineral bands beneath bed. Warm ivory walls, flat modest 2.7m ceiling and discreet small ceiling light. No huge bedroom, no lounge area or sofa, no excessive walkways, no room bigger than 13.5sqm. Compact wardrobe edge at entry, few objects, photographic linens with real weave and soft folds.
rooms.second: Room: small 7.2sqm second bedroom / study, photographed from doorway with the entire compact useful layout, approximately 2.4m wide by 3.0m deep, no impossible extra space. Right wall has built-in pale quarter-cut oak convertible single daybed, width 0.95m, cream finely woven cushion, modest cinnamon lumbar cushion and pale clay folded throw. Storage drawers under daybed. Above bed slim ivory cabinets whose visible outer end is softly curved, shallow open niche with a few books. Back wall window with slim bronze frame and Shanghai residential view; under it slim pale-oak desk with rounded corner, only 1.0m wide and 0.45m deep, slender comfortable ivory chair. Small amber-glass desk lamp, quiet ivory plaster walls, pale oak floor. Narrow luxury ivory fine-wool runner with subtle fine grey bands. Natural daylight, functional beautiful compact modern apartment room, flat 2.7m ceiling. No queen bed, no large desk, no oversized hanging storage looming over bed, no busy decorations.
rooms.kitchen: Room: 6.6sqm compact practical L-shaped kitchen, photographed from doorway, domestic 2.4m by 2.75m footprint. Continuous L counter under the back window and along RIGHT wall; stainless undermount sink centred under back window, two-burner black glass hob on right with integrated extractor concealed in shallow ivory upper cabinets. Pale quarter-cut oak lower cabinets, fine narrow pulls in aged bronze; ivory upper cupboards only where practical, one full-height pale-oak fridge cabinet at left entry. Honed ivory stone counter. SMALL but distinctive backsplash accent beside hob of blue-grey strongly veined natural stone, delicate charcoal cream swirling mineral veins, only accent area rather than all walls. Rest of walls warm ivory, light limestone floor, bronze narrow window frame, urban Shanghai blocks outside. A cutting board and a ceramic bowl, no clutter. Bright tactile realistic new compact kitchen, no island, no breakfast bar, no cavernous room. Modest flat 2.7m ceiling and discreet task lighting.
rooms.bath: Room: 4.3sqm small apartment bathroom, photographed from doorway in realistic compact width around 2m. Left a compact walk-in shower behind clear glass with slim bronze fittings, shower head and small niche; NO bathtub. Back/right wall a floating 0.9m vanity of light oak with sculpted integrated honed blue-grey natural stone basin and thick edge, dramatic yet refined grey/charcoal/cream swirling strong veins closely inspired by luxury mineral stone. Blue-grey stone is a small concentrated vanity accent only, remaining walls warm light ivory limestone tiles. Above vanity softly rounded rectangular mirror with a warm amber perimeter glow and one small amber glass wall lamp. Small high narrow privacy window provides bright natural light; bronze frame. White compact toilet at foreground right. Functional towel rail, one ivory towel, one brown glass soap bottle. Pale floor, fine clean grout, warm restrained bronze hardware, flat 2.7m ceiling. Airy bright Japanese influenced warm contemporary bathroom, not dark hotel bathroom, no freestanding tub, no huge double vanity, no blue walls.
rooms.utility: Room: tiny 2.5sqm enclosed utility balcony, narrow practical domestic space, photographed from doorway along its length. At the far end a stacked washer and dryer neatly fitted into a pale quarter-cut oak cabinetry bay with obvious narrow louvred ventilation above and below appliances and service clearances, two appliance doors correctly proportioned. A slim tall broom cupboard next to stack and small open cleaning niche. RIGHT side a small fold counter of ivory honed stone over cupboard, linen basket below, no clutter. LEFT side large side windows with slim bronze aluminium framing, one narrow side casement visibly open slightly for ventilation, Shanghai urban residential view and trees. Warm ivory plaster/tiles and light oak, flat simple low 2.7m ceiling, bright natural daylight. One small amber glass ceiling fixture or subtle warm strip accent, restrained sophistication, no oversized laundry room, no sink island, no people, logos or legible appliance text.
